messages:
marta: Drafted the relnotes for today's docs push — includes the Adaptive Routing explainer + a short migration note for VPC customers. PR #3345 is up. Can someone QA the Go SDK snippet and the anchor redirects? ping @ben @sai :wave:
ben: Looking now. Quick skim — Go example uses the old client.New() call, needs updating to NewClientWithOpts per the v0.6 API. I'll drop a patch in the PR. :+1:
sai: I'll test the anchor redirects locally. Noticing that long anchors (with query params) are being stripped on publish, causing old in-product links to 404. Filed issue in docs repo: docs#1219.
jules: Also found an edge case in the streaming example for embeddings: if chunk_size < 256 the client backpressure path can block forever in Go. Added a note under Known Issues — need a short mitigation snippet.
marta: Good catch. For the Go snippet, can you make the minimal patch and include a one-line compatibility note? Something like "If you upgraded from v0.5, replace client.New(...) with NewClientWithOpts(...)". Also we should add a redirect TTL note under "Publishing quirks" so PMs can update external links.
ben: Patch pushed to PR #3345 with a tiny diff: ```diff
- c := client.New("$API_KEY")
+ c := client.NewClientWithOpts(client.WithAPIKey("$API_KEY"))
```
ben: Left a short comment about context usage in the streaming example too.
docs-bot: Scheduled docs deploy: docs-staging -> prod at 2024-07-28T22:00Z if all blocking comments are resolved. CI: passing, 1 flaky test.
sai: Reproduced the anchor strip locally. Root cause looks like the anchor sanitizer in the publishing pipeline that normalizes URLs. I can add a whitelist for documented anchors (short-term). Will open a tiny PR.
lia: FYI product requested a blurb about deduped webhook failures in the relnotes — low priority but want it in the 'Known issues' section. Should be one sentence.
marta: Okay add this copy to Known Issues: "Intermittent duplicate webhook retries may be visible in audit logs; we are rolling a fix next week. If you rely on strict exactly-once delivery, temporarily filter by idempotency_key."
jules: For the embeddings streaming mitigation, propose this snippet: ```go
// mitigate tiny chunk deadlock: use a larger buffer
buf := make([]byte, 512)
stream.Read(buf)
``` We should mark it as a temporary workaround.
ben: LGTM. small wording nit: change "exactly-once delivery" -> "idempotent processing recommended" in the blurb.
marta: updated text in PR. Can someone sanity-check the doc anchor redirects section copy? I wrote: "Note: published anchors may be normalized; include explicit fragment identifiers in external links and validate after publish. If you see 404s, file docs#1219."
sai: That reads fine. Add an example showing the normalization: `/guides#config?tab=advanced` -> `/guides#config` so people know what's happening.
docs-bot: Reminder: release notes checklist incomplete — missing: screenshots (1), localization flags (EN only), and UX approval.
lia: I'll handle screenshots and localization flag. UX approval — @philip is on PTO until tomorrow, but he gave a verbal OK earlier. I'll attach the mock.
ben: CI caught a linting error in the Go sample; fixed in the same branch. Running `go vet` locally passed.
marta: Great. Plan: resolve PR comments by EOD, stage for deploy, merge once docs-bot shows green. If anything blocks later, we'll revert the relnotes page and ship the code-only change.
sai: Opened PR for whitelist fix: docs#1220, small change, tests added.
jules: I updated Known Issues with the embedding workaround + a TODO to remove after runtime patch.
ben: All requested patches merged into #3345. One remaining item: confirm redirects smoke test after staging deploy. I can run the script: `scripts/check-anchors.sh staging`
marta: Perfect. After smoke test pass, I'll cut the relnote publish. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
